items.exampleEn: She did well in her academic subjects.
items.exampleZh: 她在學術科目上表現很好。

items.exampleEn: This street has many historical buildings.
items.exampleZh: 這條街有很多歷史建築。

items.exampleEn: Follow the instructions on the box.
Teaching is hard work, but I love it.
items.exampleZh: 教書是辛苦的工作，但我很喜歡。

items.exampleEn: The experiment showed that plants need light.
items.exampleZh: 這個實驗顯示植物需要光。

items.exampleEn: Music is part of the school curriculum.
items.exampleZh: 音樂是學校課程的一部分。

items.exampleEn: She is a scholar who studies old languages.
items.exampleZh: 她是研究古代語言的學者。

items.exampleEn: Scientists still have many questions about the universe.
items.exampleZh: 科學家對宇宙仍有許多疑問。

items.sentenceEn: There are many stars in the universe.

items.audioEn: Before we start the experiment, please read the instructions carefully and wear your safety glasses.
items.audioZh: 開始實驗前，請仔細閱讀說明並戴上護目鏡。
items.questionZh: 實驗開始前要先做什麼？
options: Read the steps and clean your glasses.
Check the directions and protect your eyes.

items.sentenceZh: 她的教學讓數學變得有趣。
學生需要良好的學業能力。

items.stemEn: Our school's new ____ includes more science classes.
items.stemZh: 我們學校的新課程包含更多自然科學課。

items.stemEn: The museum shows ____ objects, like old coins and maps.
items.stemZh: 博物館展出有歷史意義的物品，例如古錢幣和地圖。

items.passageEn: Our science teacher's teaching style is different. Instead of giving long instructions, she lets us learn by doing experiments, not just by studying theory. After each experiment, we draw a graph of our results. She often tells us stories about scientists in history, like a scholar who studied the stars hundreds of years ago and wrote a book about the universe. She says our curriculum is not only about academic results. It is also about learning to ask good questions.
items.passageZh: 我們自然老師的教學風格很不一樣。她不給冗長的說明，而是讓我們透過做實驗來學習，不只是讀理論。每次實驗後，我們會把結果畫成圖表。她常常講歷史上科學家的故事，例如幾百年前一位研究星星、寫過關於宇宙的書的學者。她說我們的課程不只關乎學業成績，也是在學習提出好的問題。

questions.questionZh: 老師上課的方式有什麼不同？
options: 讓學生透過做實驗來學習

questions.questionZh: 老師說課程除了學業成績還關乎什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們在自然課做了一個實驗。
referenceEn: We did an experiment in science class.
We did an experiment in our science class.
rubricZh: experiment 表示「實驗」，例如 do an experiment 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 historical 造一個句子，說說你去過或想去的歷史景點。
referenceEn: I visited a historical temple with my family.
I want to visit a historical town one day.
rubricZh: historical 表示「歷史的、有關歷史的」，例如 historical buildings 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）
